caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic watering can set against a plain, light-colored background. The can has a conical body with a wide circular base that tapers as it rises towards the top. There is a large, curved handle attached to the left side of the can, running from near the middle of the height to just below the rim. The spout extends diagonally up and out from the right side, ending in a narrow, slightly flared tip. The can appears to have a hinged, rounded lid. The surface of the watering can is depicted with varying shades of gray, indicating a metal texture with patched dark spots and areas of mottled shading, giving the impression of age or use. The overall composition centers the watering can, with no other objects or background elements present. In the bottom left corner, there is a small inscription or signature that reads “Amelia Jacob”.
title: Sperm Oil Can
